description: This file contains unit tests for the QUIC crypto server stream, including handshake procedures, policy enforcement, and crash regression tests, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerStreamTest
classes.description: Unit test class for QUIC server-side crypto stream, testing handshake and policy behaviors.

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerStreamTestWithFailingProofSource
classes.description: Test class for QUIC crypto server stream with a proof source that fails.

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerStreamTestWithFakeProofSource
classes.description: Test class for QUIC crypto server stream with a fake proof source, including crash regression tests.

methods.name: NotInitiallyConected
methods.description: Test that server stream is not encrypted or has no 1-RTT keys before handshake.

methods.name: ConnectedAfterCHLO
methods.description: Test that server stream becomes encrypted after completing handshake.

methods.name: ForwardSecureAfterCHLO
methods.description: Test that server stream achieves forward secure encryption after handshake.

methods.name: ZeroRTT
methods.description: Test that 0-RTT handshake is attempted and resumption is recognized.

methods.name: FailByPolicy
methods.description: Test handshake failure when server policy rejects client hello.

methods.name: MessageAfterHandshake
methods.description: Test that server closes connection if message received after handshake.

methods.name: BadMessageType
methods.description: Test that server closes connection on invalid message type.

methods.name: OnlySendSCUPAfterHandshakeComplete
methods.description: Test that server does not send server config update before handshake completes.

methods.name: SendSCUPAfterHandshakeComplete
methods.description: Test that server can send and client can verify server config update after handshake.

methods.name: Test
methods.description: Regression test for crash when proof source fails.

methods.name: MultipleChlo
methods.description: Regression test for crash when multiple CHLOs arrive in quick succession.
